title: Elements library
description: Reusable multi-file elements (character, location, prop) living in a user library outside projects: id + fields + user-named groups of files or links, one active item per group, read by key. Surfaces: Elements workspace, the + popup with a create tile, and a Reuse-style dialog on every drop into the PromptBox. Brainstormed 2026-09-19; mods excluded from v1.
